detail.title: Stinger 321 Extension Board - 3 AC + 2 USB + 1 Fast Type-C, 10A
detail.overview: The Ant Stinger 321 is a compact extension board with 3 AC sockets, 2 USB ports (2.1A) and 1 fast-charging Type-C port, built for everyday home and office power needs in a 10A-rated package. A one-key master switch lets you cut power to the whole strip at once, while built-in surge protection guards connected devices from voltage spikes. Overload and child safety protection add extra peace of mind for households with young children, making the Stinger 321 a practical, safety-focused multi-plug power strip for everyday charging and appliance use.
